CE1.label: Low effort

CE1.1.label: Quick first-contact resolution
CE1.1.description: Issue resolved on the first contact with minimal back-and-forth.

CE1.2.label: Guided self-service
CE1.2.description: Customer was guided to a self-service tool or FAQ that resolved the issue.

CE1.description: Issue resolved quickly with minimal customer effort.

CE2.label: Medium effort

CE2.1.label: Multiple troubleshooting steps required
CE2.1.description: Several diagnostic steps needed but issue resolved in one session.

CE2.2.label: Information repeated
CE2.2.description: Customer had to repeat their information or issue description more than once.

CE2.description: Resolution required several steps but remained within one contact.

CE3.label: High effort

CE3.1.label: Multiple contacts required
CE3.1.description: Customer contacted support more than once to resolve the same issue.

CE3.2.label: Long resolution time
CE3.2.description: Issue took a significant amount of time or multiple sessions to resolve.

CE3.description: Customer had to expend significant effort across multiple interactions.

CE4.label: Very high effort

CE4.1.label: Issue unresolved after multiple contacts
CE4.1.description: Customer made multiple contacts and the issue remains unresolved.

CE4.2.label: Customer expressed significant frustration
CE4.2.description: Customer explicitly expressed frustration, anger, or loss of confidence.

CE4.description: Extreme effort required; customer clearly frustrated or issue unresolved.
